concept.title: Site search
concept.shortdesc: Search is powered by Pagefind, which indexes the generated pages after the build; readers get a fast client-side search with no server and no external services.

conbody.p: When search is enabled, every page carries a Search this site link to a search page, and only topic content is indexed — navigation, headers, and footers never appear in results. The index and the search interface are part of the output directory, so the site remains fully self-contained.

section.title: Enabling search
section.p: Install Pagefind (a single self-contained binary) and build as normal: the default govuk.search=auto switches search on whenever the binary is found on the PATH, or at the location given by govuk.pagefind.cmd.

ul.li: auto — search on when Pagefind is found; otherwise the build completes without search and says so in the log
yes — search required; the build fails if Pagefind is missing
no — search off even when Pagefind is installed

section.note: Without JavaScript the search page explains that search is unavailable; everything else on the site works as normal.
